injuries.name: Igor Chernyshov
injuries.note: Chernyshov remains on injured reserve and has missed the last 11 games after blocking a shot in Ottawa on Oct. 22. While an exact timeline for Chernyshov's return to the lineup hasn't been established, it's probably reasonable to assume that he will be out until sometime in December.

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: Musty suffered an upper-body injury ahead of training camp and was expected to have a long-term absence. He's been on non-roster injured reserve to begin the regular season, and it's not yet clear when he'll be deemed healthy. Once the 21-year-old is cleared to return to game action, he'll presumably be sent to AHL San Jose.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: The Sharks announced in mid-September that Keyser was facing a long-term absence due to an upper-body injury, so his placement on non-roster injured reserve isn't particularly surprising. Once he's cleared to return, the 27-year-old will likely report to AHL San Jose.

injuries.name: Jake O'Brien
injuries.note: O'Brien has been on non-roster injured reserve since the start of the regular season, but he's been with the team in Seattle and has been skating off to the side recently. Despite the 19-year-old's recent on-ice activity, it doesn't appear as though he's particularly close to being cleared for game action.

injuries.name: Jared McCann
injuries.note: McCann had one goal in five games before sitting out Saturday's 5-1 loss to Minnesota. He has earned five assists, eight points, 28 shots on net, three blocked shots and six hits in 11 appearances this season. With McCann unavailable, Kaapo Kakko moved up to the top line in Saturday's game.

injuries.name: Igor Chernyshov
injuries.note: Upper Body: The San Jose Sharks said on Sunday (Nov. 15) that Chernyshov is not close to returning to game action, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: Upper body: The San Jose Sharks placed G Kyle Keyser on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: Upper body: The San Jose Sharks said on Sunday (Nov. 15) that Musty is not close to returning to game action, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

injuries.name: Kiefer Sherwood
injuries.note: Arm: The Sharks said on Tuesday (Nov. 17) that Sherwood won't require surgery but is considered week-to-week, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

injuries.name: Jared McCann
injuries.note: Lower-Body: McCann will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday (Oct. 25).

injuries.name: Jake O'Brien
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Seattle Kraken said on Thursday (Nov. 19) that O'Brien remains week-to-week, per Mike Benton of the Kraken Audio Network.
